scope: Independent review and focused unittest probes of new C21J evidence-admission gates only

findings.original_issue: Replay verify_inputs accepted self-declared source/return maps and contradictory provenance, including empty maps.
findings.fix: Raw INPUT_PINS file SHA is checked by run before verification or execution; verify_inputs checks provenance fields and canonical JSON authority before every required file.
evidence: Authentic fixed 24-source/60-return set verifies exactly 84 entries.
Empty/reduced maps, contradictory metadata, changed expected file record, extra path, and extra claim are rejected.
Same-size source byte drift is rejected by the subsequent payload gate.
Canonical-equivalent raw pin reformat is rejected before verify_inputs or output creation.

findings.original_issue: Replay rpc_pairs accepted matched prefixes without a terminal and full streams with failed terminal results.
findings.fix: RPC admission requires fixed hello, expected config, ordered paired supported operations, successful complete terminal matching result, exact counts, and no post-terminal traffic.
evidence: Frozen 155-pair segment accepted with default sibling config/result and with explicit expected records.
Truncated matched prefix, missing/failed/incomplete terminal and post-terminal traffic are rejected.
Hello/config identity, signed zero in config and terminal state, operation/id/shape, result counters, duplicate JSON keys and nonfinite constants are checked by focused rejection probes.

findings.original_issue: Trace analyzer recorded hashes from arbitrary return inputs and compared selected payloads only with a self-supplied job receipt, without a frozen raw-input authority.
findings.fix: CLI supplies a fixed SHA for the 155-entry package payload manifest, and every return Inputs.read checks membership and payload hash. The five original source pins remain separate.
evidence: Authentic manifest admits the pinned public job receipt.
A self-consistent replacement manifest is rejected; CLI rejects it before job analysis.
A same-size changed job receipt is rejected before JSON parsing; an unlisted file is rejected.
All three LIVE_INVENTORY paths in the manifest are rejected before any payload read_bytes call.
